title: Seven More Body Words, Spaced on Purpose

lessons.title: Retrieval 1 — mora, politeness, and し
lessons.headword: い・し・ありがとうございます
lessons.gloss: first long-distance script and politeness retrieval

segments.text: Say い and count its one mora aloud.

segments.instruction: い and し from memory

segments.text: Hear and say the first seven-word body map.

segments.source: [YOU READ: the first seven-word body map]
[YOU WRITE: the first seven-word body map]

segments.text: Finish by isolating あし.
Hear a polite thank-you and say it.

segments.instruction: ありがとうございます
segments.source: [YOU READ: **ありがとうございます**]

segments.text: Then choose it for someone outside your close circle.
Stop after one accurate round.

segments.prompt: Write i, shi, the polite thank-you, and the seven-word body map; label each spoken unit a mora.
acceptedResponses: い・し・ありがとうございます・て・みみ・くち・あし・はな・かお・め; mora; polite
い し ありがとうございます て みみ くち あし はな かお め mora polite

feedback.correct: The distant and recent returns are in place.
feedback.incorrect: Retrieve い, し, the polite thank-you, and the first seven body words.

lessons.title: Seven more body words, spaced on purpose
lessons.headword: あたま・かみ・は・かた・おなか・せなか・こし
lessons.romanization: atama, kami, ha, kata, onaka, senaka, koshi
lessons.gloss: head, hair, tooth, shoulder, belly, back, waist

needs: your eyes, to read the printed text yourself
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your eyes, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want your eyes, to read the printed text yourself. The questions are about what you read, so save the whole lesson for when you have stopped.

segments.text: Then hear and say any three words from the first seven-word body map.
あたま・かみ・は・かた・おなか・せなか・こし (atama, kami, ha, kata, onaka, senaka, koshi).
Every sign is earned, and every new word has already had short and medium retrieval scheduled in this chapter.
Listen and give each English meaning; say all seven.
Stop after one accurate seven-word map.
Source: Japan Foundation Marugoto A1 vocabulary database.

segments.prompt: Write head, hair, tooth, shoulder, belly, back, and waist in Japanese.
acceptedResponses: あたま・かみ・は・かた・おなか・せなか・こし
あたま かみ は かた おなか せなか こし

feedback.incorrect: Return in order: あたま, かみ, は, かた, おなか, せなか, こし.
